BankTemplateConfig.description:
Bank configuration fields within a template manifest.

Only includes configurable (per-bank) fields. Credential fields
(API keys, base URLs) are intentionally excluded for security.

retain_mission.description: Steers what gets extracted during retain
retain_mission.title: Retain Mission

retain_chunk_size.description: Target max characters for each content chunk
retain_chunk_size.title: Retain Chunk Size

retain_structured_chunk_size.description: Max characters for a single JSONL line or conversation turn to keep whole; defaults to retain_chunk_size when unset
retain_structured_chunk_size.title: Retain Structured Chunk Size

enable_temporal_retrieval.description: Toggle the temporal arm (and its date-aware query analysis) during recall
enable_temporal_retrieval.title: Enable Temporal Retrieval

enable_graph_retrieval.description: Toggle the entity/link graph arm during recall
enable_graph_retrieval.title: Enable Graph Retrieval

entities_allow_free_form.description: Allow entities outside the label vocabulary
entities_allow_free_form.title: Entities Allow Free Form

retain_default_strategy.description: Name of the default retain strategy (key into retain_strategies map)
retain_default_strategy.title: Retain Default Strategy

retain_strategies.description: Map of retain strategy name to per-strategy config dict
retain_strategies.title: Retain Strategies

retain_chunk_batch_size.description: Max chunks per streaming batch (0 disables batching)
retain_chunk_batch_size.title: Retain Chunk Batch Size

mcp_enabled_tools.description: MCP tool allowlist for this bank (None = all tools)
mcp_enabled_tools.title: Mcp Enabled Tools

consolidation_llm_batch_size.description: LLM batch size for observation consolidation
consolidation_llm_batch_size.title: Consolidation Llm Batch Size

consolidation_source_facts_max_tokens.description: Max tokens of source facts per consolidation batch
consolidation_source_facts_max_tokens.title: Consolidation Source Facts Max Tokens

consolidation_source_facts_max_tokens_pe.description: Max tokens of source facts per observation
consolidation_source_facts_max_tokens_pe.title: Consolidation Source Facts Max Tokens Per Observation

max_observations_per_scope.description: Max observations to retain per consolidation scope
max_observations_per_scope.title: Max Observations Per Scope

observation_scope_limits.description: Per-scope overrides of max_observations_per_scope: [{"scope": ["run_*", "shared"], "limit": 1}]. Each scope is a list of fnmatch tag-globs; a consolidation scope matches under exact cover (every tag matched by a glob and every glob matched by a tag). The first matching rule wins; unmatched scopes fall back to max_observations_per_scope.
observation_scope_limits.title: Observation Scope Limits

reflect_source_facts_max_tokens.description: Max tokens of source facts per reflect call
reflect_source_facts_max_tokens.title: Reflect Source Facts Max Tokens

recall_budget_min.description: Floor for the adaptive function (after clamping)
recall_budget_min.title: Recall Budget Min

recall_budget_max.description: Ceiling for the adaptive function (after clamping)
recall_budget_max.title: Recall Budget Max

audit_log_enabled.description: Enable audit logging for this bank (overrides the server default)
audit_log_enabled.title: Audit Log Enabled

store_document_text.description: Persist raw source text (documents.original_text / chunks.chunk_text). Set false to keep only derived facts.
store_document_text.title: Store Document Text

consolidation_max_memories_per_round.description: Max memory units fed into a single consolidation round
consolidation_max_memories_per_round.title: Consolidation Max Memories Per Round

consolidation_llm_parallelism.description: Number of consolidation LLM batches processed concurrently
consolidation_llm_parallelism.title: Consolidation Llm Parallelism

recall_include_chunks.description: Include raw chunks in recall results
recall_include_chunks.title: Recall Include Chunks

recall_max_tokens.description: Max tokens of results returned by recall
recall_max_tokens.title: Recall Max Tokens

recall_chunks_max_tokens.description: Max tokens of raw chunks returned by recall (when recall_include_chunks is set)
recall_chunks_max_tokens.title: Recall Chunks Max Tokens

memory_defense.description: Memory Defense policy for this bank (validated against the DefensePolicy schema on write)
memory_defense.title: Memory Defense

id.title: Id

name.title: Name

LabelGroup.description: A label group (dimension) with its type and allowed values.
LabelGroup.title: LabelGroup

LabelValue.description: A single allowed value for a label group.
LabelValue.title: LabelValue

MapField.description: A field within a map-type entity label group. Supports recursion via type='map'.
MapField.title: MapField

MentalModelTrigger.description: Trigger settings for a mental model.

mode.description: Refresh mode. 'full' (default) regenerates the mental model content from scratch on each refresh. 'delta' performs surgical edits against the existing content: unchanged sections are preserved byte-for-byte, stale content is removed, new content is added. If the mental model has no existing content, or if the source_query has changed since the last refresh, delta mode falls back to a full regeneration automatically.
mode.title: Mode

refresh_after_consolidation.description: If true, refresh this mental model after observations consolidation (real-time mode)
refresh_after_consolidation.title: Refresh After Consolidation

refresh_cron.description: Cron expression (UTC, standard 5-field syntax, e.g. '0 3 * * *' for daily at 03:00 UTC) for refreshing this mental model on a fixed schedule. Mutually exclusive with refresh_after_consolidation — a model refreshes either after consolidation or on a cron schedule, not both. A scheduled refresh only runs when the model is stale (new memories in its scope since the last refresh); if nothing changed, the tick is skipped to avoid a wasted LLM call. null = no schedule.
refresh_cron.title: Refresh Cron

fact_types.description: Filter which fact types are retrieved during reflect. None means all types (world, experience, observation).
fact_types.title: Fact Types

exclude_mental_models.description: If true, exclude all mental models from the reflect loop (skip search_mental_models tool).
exclude_mental_models.title: Exclude Mental Models

exclude_mental_model_ids.description: Exclude specific mental models by ID from the reflect loop.
exclude_mental_model_ids.title: Exclude Mental Model Ids

tags_match.description: Override how the model's tags filter memories during refresh. If not set, defaults to 'all_strict' when the model has tags (security isolation) or 'any' when the model has no tags. Set to 'any' to include untagged memories alongside tagged ones during refresh.
tags_match.title: Tags Match

tag_groups.description: Compound boolean tag expressions to use during refresh instead of the model's own tags. When set, these tag groups are passed to reflect and the model's flat tags are NOT used for filtering. Supports nested and/or/not expressions for complex tag-based scoping, plus entity leaves ({entities: [names], match: any|all}) that scope by what a memory is ABOUT rather than which tag compartment it lives in -- matched case-insensitively against canonical entity names, including entities reached through an observation's source memories. The same expressions drive the staleness gate, so an entity-scoped model refreshes exactly when facts about its entities arrive. Entity leaves may not appear under 'not'.
tag_groups.title: Tag Groups

include_chunks.description: Override whether the internal recall used during refresh returns raw chunk text. None means use the bank/global config default (recall_include_chunks).
include_chunks.title: Include Chunks

recall_max_tokens.description: Override the token budget for facts returned by the internal recall during refresh. None means use the bank/global config default (recall_max_tokens).
recall_max_tokens.title: Recall Max Tokens

recall_chunks_max_tokens.description: Override the token budget for raw chunks returned by the internal recall during refresh. None means use the bank/global config default (recall_chunks_max_tokens).
recall_chunks_max_tokens.title: Recall Chunks Max Tokens

delta_fast_path.description: Override whether a delta refresh may take the deterministic fast path: fetch the memories created since the last refresh and, if there are any, turn them into edit operations with a single LLM call instead of running the agentic reflect loop. An empty window costs no LLM call at all. The fast path hands back to the loop whenever a surgical edit is not obviously safe, so every outcome is preserved either way. None means use the bank/global config default (mental_model_delta_fast_path). Ignored in full mode, which never takes the fast path.
delta_fast_path.title: Delta Fast Path

response_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for structured output. When set, each refresh runs the same structured-output extraction as reflect's response_schema and stores the parsed result under reflect_response.structured_output alongside the markdown content.
response_schema.title: Response Schema

keep_trace.description: If true, every refresh of this mental model records how it reached its result under reflect_response.trace: the mode it ran in and why, the resolved scope and time window, how many facts retrieval returned versus how many the agent used, the tool and LLM calls, and any delta operations. Only the latest refresh's trace is kept. This is the only way to diagnose a cron- or consolidation-driven refresh after the fact, since no human sees those run. Tool outputs are reduced to result counts to keep the stored trace bounded; use LLM request tracing for raw prompts and responses.
keep_trace.title: Keep Trace

TagGroupEntityLeaf.description:
A leaf ENTITY filter: matches memories by the entities they mention.

Tags describe which *compartment* a memory lives in; entities describe what it
is *about*. On a bank whose tag vocabulary is a handful of broad topics, a tag
scope cannot isolate a subject — measured on a production bank (2026-08-08),
the best tag scope for one subject reached 25% precision against a 15.5% base
rate, while the entity association reached 94.2% precision / 86.2% recall on
the same corpus. This leaf makes that association usable anywhere a
``TagGroup`` already is: mental-model refresh scope, the staleness gate, and
retrieval filtering, through the same recursive grammar.

``entities`` are canonical names, matched case-insensitively — the same
normalisation the entity registry itself enforces via its
``(bank_id, LOWER(canonical_name))`` uniqueness.

Association is inheritance-aware: a memory matches if it links the entity
directly (``unit_entities``) or through any of its ``source_memory_ids`` — the
lane observations use, since consolidation-produced observations carry no
direct postings by design (their entity association is transitive through
their sources; see ``memories/pg/graph.py:_entity_rows_for_units_sql``).

``match="any"``: mentions at least one listed entity. ``match="all"``: mentions
every listed entity (directly or via sources, per entity).

Constraints, enforced by ``validate_entity_leaf_placement`` at the API edge:
an entity leaf may not appear under ``not`` — the two permissive fallbacks
(the Python-side post-filter and the non-memory_units surfaces that strip
entity leaves) evaluate an unknown entity constraint as "matches", and a NOT
over a permissive "matches" silently inverts into "exclude everything".
TagGroupEntityLeaf.title: TagGroupEntityLeaf

TagGroupLeaf.description: A leaf tag filter: matches memories by tag list and match mode.
TagGroupLeaf.title: TagGroupLeaf

TagGroupNot.description: Compound NOT group: child filter must NOT match.
TagGroupNot.title: TagGroupNot

TagGroupOr.description: Compound OR group: at least one child filter must match.
TagGroupOr.title: TagGroupOr
